subject.title: fix(google-vertex): add Google Vertex AI onboarding wizard, fix ADC auth, add provider docs

question: Should OpenClaw accept this google-vertex ADC onboarding contract as the bundled core setup path, including permissive ADC evidence, global location default, marker profile, default model registration, and provider-name transport fallback?
rationale: The code path is coherent and proof-supplied, but it intentionally changes auth detection and setup-written defaults for an existing bundled provider, which is a maintainer product/compatibility choice rather than an automated repair decision.

options.title: Accept the ADC setup contract
options.body: Merge or land an adapted version with the permissive auth evidence and additive onboarding writes as the intended Google Vertex setup behavior.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Keep the old stricter gate or make metadata-server ADC opt-in, and reduce onboarding writes to the minimum state maintainers want setup to own.

options.title: Pause behind the Vertex cluster
options.body: Keep this PR open but defer merge until #60736 and overlapping Vertex PRs settle the permanent provider boundary and location/model strategy.

recommendation.title: Accept the ADC setup contract
recommendation.body: Merge or land an adapted version with the permissive auth evidence and additive onboarding writes as the intended Google Vertex setup behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged Vertex ADC transport work is the closest current-main ownership signal for deciding whether this onboarding/auth contract matches the intended provider behavior.
